name: File Search
purpose: Find approved local files and folders without another extension.
access_review: Review indexed folders and keep sensitive locations out of scope.

name: Clipboard History
purpose: Find and paste recent clipboard entries.
access_review: Disable capture in 1Password, Passwords, Keychain Access and sensitive work apps.

name: Quicklinks
purpose: Open Day One guides, folders and approved web dashboards.
access_review: Do not store tokens or secret-bearing URLs.

name: Snippets
purpose: Insert reviewed reusable text without shell automation.
access_review: Disable expansion in password and keychain applications.

name: Window Management
purpose: Move and resize development windows from the keyboard.
access_review: Requires Accessibility; skip when company policy disallows it.

name: Warp
purpose: Open Warp tabs, windows and launch configurations from Raycast.
access_review: Vendor extension; review URI targets before opening them.

name: Visual Studio Code
purpose: Search and open recent VS Code projects.
access_review: Community extension; grant only the editor access it needs.

name: GitHub
purpose: Work with GitHub issues, pull requests, repositories and notifications.
access_review: Uses GitHub authentication; confirm personal versus work account before connecting.

name: GitHub Copilot
purpose: Delegate work to GitHub Copilot coding agent.
access_review: Official publisher; confirm organisation Copilot policy and repository scope.

name: Obsidian
purpose: Search, create and open notes across approved vaults.
access_review: Community extension; configure only intended vault paths and exclusions.

name: Can I Use
purpose: Check browser support for web platform features.
access_review: Queries public compatibility data; no project credentials are needed.

name: Kill Process
purpose: Find a process consuming CPU or memory.
access_review: Terminating a process is destructive; inspect the exact process first.

name: Port Manager
purpose: Inspect listening ports and their owning processes.
access_review: Closing a port terminates work; use inspection before action.
